shared_rules_changes: Private ScaledPowerDamage(source group, recipient group, factor) uses current legal creature characteristics, then the existing noncombat damage and replacement pipeline. Existing Fight/PowerDamage use factor one.

Private ActivationGuard::GraveyardCardsAtLeast(kind, minimum), evaluated by one borrowed actual/speculative owner/kind/non-token graveyard helper. It is a starting restriction, with no resolution guard.

reused_recipe.recipe: 2/1 black Villain creature token with menace; Arnim creates it tapped.

Punishing Punch.cost: Actual full 2G payment for zero/one own graveyard creature and actual G payment for two; opponent graveyards and noncreatures excluded. Colored mana request remains mandatory and private. Generic reduction uses an existing typed CountFilter expression.
Punishing Punch.targets: Separate own-creature/opponent-creature groups reject wrong relations, lands and players atomically; departure, blink, control change or enemy hexproof after binding prevents all damage when either target is illegal.
Punishing Punch.damage: Paid Giant Growth response changes power before damage; current power is doubled before damage replacements. Negative/zero power deals no damage. Source lifelink/deathtouch apply, source takes no return damage, Black Panther prevention is respected, and paid Twinflame Tyrant doubles the resulting damage.

Arnim Zola, Bio-Fanatic.body: Actual 2B cast; legendary black 2/3 artifact creature, Scientist Villain, with no other printed keywords.
Arnim Zola, Bio-Fanatic.restriction_and_cost: Requires two actual creature cards owned by the activating player in their graveyard; opponents, noncreatures and tokens excluded. Summoning sickness, tapped source, wrong payment and underpayment reject atomically; actual generic-three payment taps the source.
Arnim Zola, Bio-Fanatic.starting_only: Removing both graveyard creatures after activation does not stop token creation. Actual nested Rubble Rouser mana payment exiles one of the two creatures while paying; the false guard does not prevent completing the original activation.
Arnim Zola, Bio-Fanatic.captured_controller_and_incarnation: Queued ability creates the token for its captured controller after source control change, departure or blink; a different owner does not redirect the token. Current controller graveyard and token replacement effects apply when activating a stolen Arnim.
Arnim Zola, Bio-Fanatic.token: Existing exact recipe is tapped, black, 2/1, Villain and menace; recipient Doubling Season creates two tapped tokens. Actual combat permits one tentative blocker but rejects finishing until a second blocker is declared.

xmage_discrepancy: Pinned ActivateIfConditionActivatedAbility.getEffects rechecks the condition during resolution. Official MSH release notes explicitly state that removing graveyard creature cards after activation cannot stop resolution; follow Oracle and CR602 starting restrictions instead.
owned_and_privacy: Existing big_helpers::checked verifies wrong-actor atomicity, owned raw/index equality after dropping a parent, snapshot restore/stale revision, and repeated-action equality at every legal decision in both seats. Illegal actions preserve snapshot and revision. Payment requests and suspended nested payment details are hidden from the nonactor; hands remain hidden.
fixtures: Existing admitted supporting cards and production helpers are used. Starting readiness/growth/graveyard/control and combat phase fixtures use existing scenario state setup; consequential casts, targeting, payments, damage replacements and combat choices use actual legal actions. No new test hooks, parser rules or bots.

trace_audit.comparison: Every inherited full Trace object exactly equal; no schema projection or omitted fields.

validation.source_link_format: check_sources.py verifies all 5,396 definitions and 1,135 unique Java blobs. Final linker --check, changed Rust format checks and git diff --check pass. Full frozen Oracle/direct Java/helper pins are in paired records.
validation.full_release: Required exact final published integration head python3 scripts/validate.py --release and two independent nonauthor reviews remain integration gates; no separate redundant release job in this author checkout.
validation.early_runs: Initial test-only fixture/API compile errors were repaired after terminal completion. One queued unit was explicitly stopped before consuming source to fix a new test borrow typo, then polled to terminal; its report is not counted as a test pass. All logs are retained.

resource_safety: Cargo ran only through resource_guard.py with one global build, one job/test thread and a 6 GiB shared memory cap. Every completed measured unit reports zero OOM and OOM kills.

cleanup.allocation_caveat: Sum of per-path allocated blocks; not an independently measured physical reclaim amount because hard links may share storage.

throughput.scope: Two whole physical candidate cards, two narrow private mechanics, source/rules evidence and focused/trace verification. Includes serialized build waits and fixture repair. These are candidate counts, not newly merged cards.
throughput.simulation_benchmark: Not run. Native scenario timings are not a set simulation benchmark.

remaining_scope: No further scaled-damage or graveyard-guard consumers expanded before these two first whole representatives are reviewed and integrated. All other gated MSH obligations and full 281-card MSH-only game/performance acceptance remain open.
